itens.trecho: Visualmente grandioso e feito com verdadeira mestria técnica e artística, é um filme com temas difíceis e indigestos, que assustará o público com a sua lentidão e ambiente cansativo. Há filmes feitos para alguns públicos e não para a maioria das pessoas, o público geral.

Terrence Malick's The Tree of Life is an attempt to inject some cosmic wonder into the most mundane American story. In the 1950s, two parents bring up three boys in an American white middle-class, small-town existence.

Visually grandiose and made with true technical and artistic mastery, it is a film with difficult and indigestible themes, which will scare the audience with its slowness and tiring atmosphere. There are films that are made for some audiences and not for most people, the general public.
